reader_question: How many people do newspaper publishers employ, and how has that changed?
grade_line: Documented: a Census Bureau count of employers
title: Newspaper publishers lost the most paid jobs from 2008 to 2013, 127,637, of any five-year step from 1998 to 2023.
measure_line: Paid employees of newspaper publishers in mid-March, every fifth year from 1998 to 2023, United States
source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, County Business Patterns, newspaper publishers (NAICS 511110), 1998 to 2023, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Establishments with paid employees only; employees counted in mid-March.
alt: Six columns of newspaper publishers’ employees, every fifth year: 1998 401,373, 2003 384,716, 2008 346,373, 2013 218,736, 2018 153,060, 2023 91,350.

table.caption: Paid employees of newspaper publishers, mid-March

notes_internal: Rule 14.13's correct plate: a still chart with every value printed and its table as live text.
